decisions.decision: Teach scene safety, response/normal-breathing observation, prompt local activation and factual handover; qualified staff use their current protocol.
decisions.remaining: Confirm local contact, response equipment and BHW authorization.
decisions.source_issue: Legacy scene and pulse-first sequence can delay activation and assumes BHW clinical scope.

decisions.decision: Use WHO IMCI danger signs and age-specific trained assessment. Continue breastfeeding when safe; use the actual ORS packet directions and safe water. Do not provide a universal recipe or dose.
decisions.remaining: Local IMCI adaptation, ORS brands, trained assessor and referral route require confirmation.
decisions.source_issue: Older temperature/respiratory cutoffs and a fixed home ORS recipe may be misapplied by age or packet size.

decisions.decision: Clear hazards, protect the head, time the event, observe breathing and seek urgent child assessment; do not restrain or insert anything into the mouth.
decisions.remaining: Qualified pediatric reviewer must confirm referral thresholds and local pathway.
decisions.source_issue: Legacy fever-wiping instructions could distract from immediate seizure safety and referral.

decisions.decision: Use current AHA adult/pediatric and drowning guidance only through a qualified trainer and appropriate manikins. Do not practise thrusts or compressions on people; water rescue requires trained responders.
decisions.remaining: Trainer certification, AED/manikin availability, rescue service and local BLS adoption require confirmation.
decisions.source_issue: Legacy CAB, generic Heimlich and drowning paragraphs do not reflect age-specific 2025 resuscitation and airway-obstruction pathways.

decisions.decision: Activate verified advice, report exposure facts and avoid improvised treatment. Medication and kit use follow current local protocols and qualified direction; no source dose is taught.
decisions.remaining: Local poison contact, cardiology/aspirin protocol, kit list and medication authority remain unverified.
decisions.source_issue: The old source gives routine water after poisoning, a fixed chemical-spill distance, repeated aspirin doses and kit medications as if possession implied authority.

decisions.decision: Teach direct pressure and prompt escalation for severe bleeding, support suspected fractures in position, cool thermal burns safely and seek assessment for concerning burns. Omit routine herbal treatment.
decisions.remaining: Qualified trainer must verify hands-on technique, dressing, immobilization and referral criteria.
decisions.source_issue: Legacy gentle pressure, herbal wound care, universal splints and burn grading could under-triage injury.

decisions.decision: Urgently escalate breathing difficulty or systemic reaction; follow authorized emergency medication plans only. For snakebite, minimize movement and transport promptly without tourniquet, incision or suction.
decisions.remaining: Confirm epinephrine access/training, snakebite transport and local facility availability.
decisions.source_issue: Local bite or sting symptoms may conceal anaphylaxis, while traditional snakebite methods cause harm.

source_allocation: F38: seven hours emergency cases plus one hour first-aid kit; 2.5/2.6/2.7 use the remaining four hours of the shared 12-hour first-aid competency.
